title: "Pilot Case"
---

## Institutional self-preservation through sacrificial escalation

> When a political institution treats prior deaths as an obligation to continue
> a destructive course, which forms of agency are necessary to explain the
> resulting behavior?

The pilot compares human rhetorical action, psychological commitment feedback,
institutional continuity, symbolic-order mediation, and a layered spiritual
proposal. Its finding remains provisional and private.
